reason: I already pay for POS, accounting and give the delivery apps their cut, and I raised my prices twice this year. Another 25 a month, 30 with VAT, for a menu page I can fix on Facebook and Google myself is money I don't have spare right now.
objection: If I stop paying, what's left? On the 25 plan it's not even my own domain, so the site, the QR codes on my tables and my menu just disappear. That's me locked in to another monthly bill.
would_change_my_mind: A free first month, plus it also updates my Google listing hours and menu, and a promise in writing that if I cancel I keep my domain and get my site and menu exported.
